//: LibreLane configuration for the Tiny Tapeout GF180 flow (gds.yaml, gf180mcuD /
gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0): tt-support-tools adds the source list, die area and
floorplan template from info.yaml and merges this file over them (harden/configure.py
does the same locally, and harden/macro.json puts the RAM32 DFFRAM macro in).
The sky130 chip's configuration this descends from is ttsky26d-um-lisa-ttlc src/config.json.
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - increase if Global Placement fails with GPL-0302.
CLOCK_PERIOD in ns.  The sky130 chip was constrained at 30 ns and runs at 50-66 MHz;
GF180's slow corner (ss, 125C, 3.0 V) is several times slower, so 40 ns (25 MHz) to start.
The promoted layout (gf17, GF180.md) was hardened at 40 ns and misses it by 1-2 ns at the typical corners;
the chip is specified at 45 ns, 22.2 MHz (info.yaml clock_hz), where those corners have 3-5 ns to spare.

PL_MAX_DISPLACEMENT_Y - the legalizer may move a cell this far (um; 100 by default): the short rows beside the RAM32 macro run full and after the hold buffers a few cells there have to leave the pocket.
Hold slack margin - increase in case of hold violations.
EXTRA_EXCLUDED_CELLS - the resizer must not use GF180's slow delay cells (~4 ns each) as fanout or wire buffers (as the Tiny Galton and PRISM ports found).
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - disabling the linter is not recommended!
The core's multi-cycle paths (the PC, the fetch window, the registered instruction, the debugger to the registers decode reaches): lisa.sdc = LibreLane's base.sdc plus those
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
!!! DO NOT CHANGE ANYTHING BELOW THIS POINT !!!
Save some time
Don't put clock buffers on the outputs
Reduce wasted space
Absolute die size
Clock
Don't generate power rings
MAGIC_DEF_LABELS may cause issues with LVS
Only export pin area in LEF (without any connected nets)
